check_text:
protocol.py: 1 biology problem (1 warning).

1. WARNING MIX-BEFORE-DRAW: Liquid drawn from 24 wells before it was mixed: added at line
77, drawn at line 79 and line 83
   line 77:  p1000.dispense(450, src_dilution_well)
   At line 77 liquid was added to wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in slot
   5, which already held a different liquid (this line did it 24 times). At line 79 and line
   83 liquid was drawn out of them again, and the well was never mixed in between. Two
   liquids layered in a small well do not mix on their own, so what the tip drew is not at
   the concentration you calculated. In a dilution series every later step inherits the
   error.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in slot 5.
   Also reached 48 other wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 40 more in slot 6.
   Fix: Mix the well after the addition at line 77: `mix_after=(5, volume)` in a transfer,
   or `pipette.mix(5, volume, well)`. Integra suggests about 5 cycles at about 80% of the
   volume in the well.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   Source: Svec et al. 2015: how good is a PCR efficiency estimate
           https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4822216/
   [fb7f2c510fbc]

The Opentrons simulator (8.8.2) passed this protocol with no error: it checks that the robot
can make the moves, not what they do to the liquids.

findings.title: Liquid drawn from 24 wells before it was mixed: added at line 77, drawn at line 79 and line 83
findings.explanation: At line 77 liquid was added to wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in slot 5, which already held a different liquid (this line did it 24 times). At line 79 and line 83 liquid was drawn out of them again, and the well was never mixed in between. Two liquids layered in a small well do not mix on their own, so what the tip drew is not at the concentration you calculated. In a dilution series every later step inherits the error.
findings.fix: Mix the well after the addition at line 77: `mix_after=(5, volume)` in a transfer, or `pipette.mix(5, volume, well)`. Integra suggests about 5 cycles at about 80% of the volume in the well.
